method: One fresh-context Codex subagent per offline next-response sample; primary agent read every output and reviewed relevant semantic criteria. No live user was queried.
model_settings: Inherited from the parent task; exact model identifier not independently observed.

baseline.notes: Useful value question and no document immunity, but no outcome-readable choices, explanation/help route, or explicit explanation of what the answer changes.
Already reframes purpose and provides a viable blank-sheet direction. Comparison with other futures and stopping is less explicit; this is not a blanket reasoning failure.
Already explains consequences, preserves uncertainty about the timer, and does not adopt a confused recommendation.
Already responds with concrete consequences and no expertise label; this is a capability to preserve, not an improvement attributable to the skill.

repair.observed: First with-skill stalled-skill sample put explanation help in a closing sentence rather than a selectable option.
repair.change: Made the explanation/help route an explicit part of the option-list structure when options are supported.
repair.rechecked: Final stalled-skill and fresh-concept outputs include selectable help.

final_samples.notes: Asks about a concrete moment when questions became burdensome, says why it matters, gives outcomes for the subsequent inquiry, and includes explanation help as a selectable route. The conversation remains at a question; a completed blank-sheet construction is not claimed.

Constructs a monthly handover service from the reconsidered value, then compares alternatives and inherited app assumptions. Names effort, market uncertainty, and conditions for avoiding further development. No live action is performed.
Explains both future work paths and their burdens in familiar language, keeps the confused default unadopted, and does not claim to control the timer or start another agent.

Leads with a concrete sequence of what the user would see and do, reflecting the explicit preference. Does not assign a competence label, invent missing prior option text, or claim a memory write. Internal counter maintenance is not observable in this sample.
Starts with desired benefit without requiring an artifact or inventing dissatisfaction. Explains where each answer leads the inquiry and includes selectable explanation help and free response.
Reopens the daily-record premise, treats the newly expressed feeling as provisional, and asks a new discriminating question instead of forcing the original options.

Keeps the user-fixed calculation rules and input data, builds a workflow from the value of removing repeated entry, then compares future work and possible reuse. Missing output obligations remain open.
In the metadata-only sample, chooses not to invoke the skill and does not introduce an interview. No actual UI edit is executed or claimed complete.
Leaves the selection pending while the user is away; neither the countdown nor preselection becomes agreement, and no new question is added.

limitations: Small synthetic response samples, not statistical improvement evidence.
Japanese scenarios only; English operation has not been behaviorally evaluated.
Text representation of questions; no live question UI or timer/default controls tested.
No end-to-end host discovery, installation refresh, external memory, or multi-agent orchestration tested.
Dialogue-internal explanation counters are not directly observable; adaptation is judged from output behavior.
Ordinary task execution and public publishing are outside the sample scope.
